description: Ad-free piano, studio tools and WAV export.
reviewNotes: Open Settings > PianoFlow Premium. The one-time purchase removes banner and app-open ads, unlocks Warm Studio and Bright Hall sounds, and enables advanced recording playback (speed, loops, selected sections), saving trimmed copies, and lossless WAV export. Record a short take, open Saved performances > Tools, and select a Premium control to see a contextual upgrade. Restore purchases is available on the Premium screen. Basic recording/replay, MIDI sharing, guided practice, and full-take Concert M4A export do not require Premium.
priceNote: Choose the production price in App Store Connect. The local StoreKit fixture price does not configure App Store pricing.
